Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    n=len(g); seen=set(); out=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    # components of 8s via 4-neighborhood; each cell colored by (size-based rank) but keeping region:
    import numpy as np
    C=np.array([[int(x) for x in r] for r in g]); n=C.shape[0]
    dirs=((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))
    seen=np.zeros_like(C,bool)
    comps=[]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if C[r][c]==8 and not seen[r,c]:
                comp=[]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r,c]=True
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in dirs:
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<n and 0<=nb<n and C[na][nb]==8 and not seen[na,nb]:
                            seen[na,nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
                comps.append(comp)
    # assign colors: sort components by their "topmost-leftmost" cell, then recolor whole component to order index+1
    order=sorted(comps,key=lambda s:min(s))
    for idx,s in enumerate(order):
        col=idx+1
        for r,q in s: out[r][q]=col
    return out

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    marked=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==8]
    # 2x2 blocks -> color 1, rest -> other colors based on position relative to block(s)
    blk=set()
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h-1):
        for c in range(w-1):
            if all(g[r+i][c+j]==8 for i in range(2) for j in range(2)) and (r,c) not in seen:
                seen.add((r,c)); blk|={(r+i,c+j) for i in range(2) for j in range(2)}
    rem=[p for p in marked if p not in blk]
    # bounding box of remaining cells
    rs=[p[0] for p in rem]; cs=[p[1] for p in rem]
    R=min(rs); C=max(cs); B=min(cs); T=max(rs)
    def comps(cells):
        seen=set(); res=[]
        for cell in cells:
            if cell in seen: continue
            stack=[cell]; comp=set()
            while stack:
                p=stack.pop()
                if p in seen: continue
                seen.add(p); comp.add(p)
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
                    if q in set(cells): stack.append(q)
            res.append(comp)
        return res
    for comp in comps(rem):
        rs_c=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs_c=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs_c),max(rs_c),min(cs_c),max(cs_c)
        sign_r = 1 if r1>R else -1
        sign_c = 1 if c1>B else -1
        dom=[(sign_r,sign_c)]
        cnt=Counter(dom)
        sgn=None
        mabn,mcbb,mabf,mcfb=None,None,None,None
        if mabn is None or True: pass
        col=None
        if sign_r==1 and sign_c==1: col=4
        elif sign_r==-1 and sign_c==-1: col=3
        elif sign_r==-1 and sign_c==1: col=2
        elif sign_r==1 and sign_c==-1: col=3
        else: col=3
        for r2,c2 in comp: out[r2][c2]=col
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi,go=G[f'{k} input'],G[f'{k} output']
    pred=solve(gi)
    print(k,'MATCH' if pred==go else 'MISMATCH')
    if pred!=go:
        for r in range(len(go)): print(''.join(map(str,pred[r])), ''.join(map(str,go[r])))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
i,o=G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output']
def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==8]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    corners=[(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)]
    out=[[g[r][c] if g[r][c]!=8 else 0 for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    for r,c in cells:
        best=None
        for cr,cc in corners:
            d=abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc)
            if best is None or d<best[0] or (d==best[0] and cr<best[1]):
                best=(d,cr,cc)
        dr=(best[1]-r0<0)*(cr==-1) or 0
        cc=(best[2]-c0<0)*(cc==-1) or 0
        # direction labels by quadrant of corners
        if best[1]==r0:
            col=4 if best[2]==c1 else 1
        else:
            col=2 if best[2]==c1 else 3
        out[r][c]=col
    return out
print(f(i)==o)
res=f(G['Test input'])
for row in res: print(row)
print(json.dumps(res))
